events.title: Major Update v0.2.1: Windowed Mode, New Guests, New Groups & Sidequests!
events.summary: Hello Overbookers,Super excited to share that I’m joining Steam Next Fest later this month! I just pushed a big update to get things ready, here’s what’s new in this patch:Settings & PerformanceWindowed Mode & Resolutions: You can now switch to windowed mode and adjust your resolution settings freely in the menu.New ContentAdded over 10 new guest characters with unique mechanics.2 New Groups: Introducing The Watch and Art Guild!Added 7 new pieces of furniture and 8 new items.3 New Room Themes: B
